message: If Kela’s conditions are met, compensation is {pct} % of eligible outstanding higher-education loan above {threshold} €, with degree-based caps. Normally this concerns your first completed degree, first admission/attendance from {cohortDate}, and completion within Kela’s deadline.

explain: Student-loan compensation is {pct} % of eligible outstanding higher-education loan above {threshold} €, with degree-based caps, not a blanket write-off. Normally it concerns the first completed higher-education degree and completion within Kela’s deadline, including accepted extensions. First admission from {cohortDate}, or earlier admission with first attendance from then, can qualify. First-cycle university graduates can apply or defer until the second-cycle degree; application requirements differ by degree/location. This is distinct from student-aid income tests, interest assistance and bank repayment breaks. Kela confirms eligibility.
